heroHeadline: Day 86: Active CJNG Narcocrematorio Discovered in Lagos de Moreno — 16+ Burning Pits Still Smoking; El Sapo Hunt Day 86; 23 Days to World Cup
heroSubtitle: Day 86 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). LAGOS DE MORENO NARCOCREMATORIO — BREAKING: Madres Buscadoras de Jalisco and Madres Buscadoras de Sonora (Ceci Flores) discovered an active CJNG clandestine crematory and training center in Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco on May 17–18. The site was still burning when found — 16+ fosas with calcined bone fragments, ash, burned tires and steel rods. 60 bags of human remains simultaneously recovered in El Salto, Jalisco (near Guadalajara airport). The discovery is directly linked to Fernando 'El Cabo' Farías de la Cruz — CJNG's forced-recruiter for the Rancho Izaguirre/La Galera extermination compound in Teuchitlán, arrested May 7 — extending the same CJNG extermination infrastructure into northeastern Jalisco. Jalisco FGE forensic teams conducting peritajes; no official body count yet. SCALE: This find, with Rancho Izaguirre (nearly 100 DNA samples, bone fragments predating 2015) and ongoing FGR Teuchitlán investigations, documents systematic CJNG forced disappearance and cremation operations spanning at least a decade across Jalisco. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 86: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large — Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. PLAN KUKULKAN — 23 DAYS: Twenty-three days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11). The Lagos de Moreno crematory — surfaced 23 days before the World Cup — intensifies international scrutiny of Mexico's security situation. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 group-stage matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 10: Ten days since El Chucky arrest (May 9) — no successor named; port under Navy-SEMAR surveillance. CJNG CHILE TRIAL: Chilean prosecutors seeking 35-year sentences for two CJNG nationals who produced 844kg meth in Chile for Australian distribution — transnational manufacturing reach documented (May 17). CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 86): Ongoing — no charges yet. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno crematory linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized.
